business_problem: EnerSys sustainability teams faced growing workloads collecting and reporting ESG data amid increasing disclosure requirements, while needing accurate, traceable data and more efficient analysis and responses to customer questionnaires.
solution_summary: EnerSys uses ESG Flo to collect Scope 1 and 2 emissions and resource-consumption data from 180 sites: site contacts upload PDF utility bills, and ESG Flo applies heat map-based machine learning to extract date range, usage amount, cost, and units while flagging anomalies and variabilities for traceable, auditable collection. The team is also piloting ESG Flo's compliance platform, where AI helps populate similar answers across ESG frameworks. Separately, staff use ChatGPT Enterprise to analyze sustainability datasets, including Scope 1 and 2 emissions, travel, and waste; they also upload sustainability reports and internal policies to generate customer questionnaire responses. Humans review outputs before external use. The article does not describe storage, APIs, or direct integration between the platforms; assistance with writing the next sustainability report remains planned.

EnerSys coded its ChatGPT Enterprise implementation to flag and reject requests involving proprietary or material information.

source_references.title: ESG Case study: How EnerSys uses GenAI to drive efficiency, ensure accuracy, and safeguard sustainability & ESG data

evidence_quotes: contacts at all 180 sites “upload PDFs of their utility bills, which the AI then processes to extract data such as date range, usage amount, cost, and units of measurement.”
They are also using it to assist in answering customer questionnaires and surveys about their sustainability practices.
Sivulka estimates that the tool has cut the time spent on questionnaires by roughly 50%.

By uploading EnerSys sustainability reports and internal policies to the ChatGPT Enterprise platform, the team can generate responses to customer inquiries more efficiently, although human review is still necessary to ensure accuracy.
